purpose: Test the literal post-479 Architect sequence RETURN TO THE SOURCE CODES / REINSERTING THE PRIME BASICS on the authenticated pre-Beaufort record without Cosmic or community-only operands.

prime_operations.select: concatenate bytes at the 24 prime positions
prime_operations.select-zero-5: same selection with the contribution assigned prime 5 omitted
prime_operations.xor-prime: copy the full layer and XOR each selected byte with p mod 256
prime_operations.color-lsb: copy the full layer and set the selected byte LSB for blue or clear it for yellow

dissemination.xor-phase32-password: XOR with the exact 64 ASCII password bytes, cycled

acceptance.half: derived uncompressed secp256k1 public key exactly equals the frozen Half public key
acceptance.better_half: hash160 of a valid compressed or uncompressed derived public key exactly equals the frozen Better Half hash160

scope_note: A complete negative closes only these literal select/mutate/disseminate/extract operations. It does not disprove every possible meaning of source codes or prime basics.
